summary: Forest Service lookout cabin on North Piney, Sublette County, WY, reported in 1941 and 1942; listed as gone, with no site description found.

facts.design: Ground-site lookout cabin, not a tower
facts.status_note: Listed as gone by the Forest Fire Lookout Association; no removal date or account found

staffing.status: manned on low-humidity days under a 1941 plan; a couple stayed about six weeks in 1942

facts.agency: U.S. Forest Service, Bridger-Teton National Forest

events.note: Forest Service lookout cabin erected in Sublette County that summer, per a July 24, 1941 Pinedale Roundup item on the history page; the item does not name North Piney
A couple stayed at the North Piney lookout about six weeks (Big Piney Examiner, September 1942)

notes_for_editor: The 1941 and 1942 items and the 1950 notice are secondhand: the history page reprints them from The Pinedale Roundup and the Big Piney Examiner, and I did not see the newspapers. The dates (July 24, 1941; September 17, 1942; October 26, 1950) are as printed on the history page. The 1941 item says 'in Sublette County' without naming North Piney; the story now says other entries on the same page name North Piney, rather than saying the page files the item under this lookout. The 1941 item calls the building a cabin, which fits the 'Ground' type. The 1950 spur sits under a Middle Piney Telephone Line entry, but the page does not call the spur itself a telephone spur, so the story no longer does. The page's title says Big Piney, but its content is the North Piney site. A separate Bald Mountain in Fremont County appears on the same listings and was not used. No removal account found. The Bridger-Teton historic survey (npshistory hcs-2.pdf) has no North Piney entry. Access not verified; no photos.
